book_intelligence_architecture.creative_excellence: granular prose/reader intelligence plus whole-book multi-resolution evidence and assurance
book_intelligence_architecture.literary_prose: governed analysis, diagnosis, retrieval, revision, independent evaluation, learning and homogenization defense
book_intelligence_architecture.rule: Recovered Book Intelligence remains federated into the parent lifecycle; later parent runtime work must consume these capabilities rather than replace them.

current_parent_critical_path.objective: Implement the parent-owned admission runtime that consumes typed responses from the qualified Service Interface Registry, verifies exact subject/projection identity and freshness, preserves abstention/disagreement/error state, deduplicates replay, records evidence and bounded integration proposals into parent state, routes author-required outcomes to the author-decision boundary, and never allows provider SUCCESS to become canonical state without explicit parent admission and lifecycle transition.
must_define: service-response intake envelope and exact request/response correlation
provider subject and parent projection freshness checks
author-decision queue handoff without fabricated approval
stale proposal invalidation after parent state change
parent admission receipt and rollback identity
strict separation between REGISTER_INTEGRATION_PROPOSAL and canonical manuscript promotion
must_not_do: treat provider SUCCESS or A-01 PASS as parent admission
allow a child/lane provider to choose ADMITTED state itself
drop minority/disagreement/abstention evidence to simplify a decision
replay a provider response into duplicate proposals or decisions
promote a manuscript candidate without required parent/author transition gates
silently accept stale evidence after parent state or rights/privacy boundaries change
closure_criteria: all four registered service families can enter the same parent-safe intake path
unknown or stale request/response/provider identities fail closed
SUCCESS remains evidence/proposal only until parent admission
ABSTAIN/PARTIAL/ERROR and disagreement are durably preserved
duplicate responses are deterministic and cannot create duplicate proposals
author-required outcomes queue rather than auto-approve
stale proposals invalidate when their exact parent projection changes
admitted proposals can satisfy later lifecycle gates only through explicit parent-owned state registration
adversarial qualification proves no direct provider-to-canon path
